About Me

NYU

Hello! My name is Andrew Chen. I am a Computer Engineering major attending New York University. I find photography a relaxing side hobby I picked up over the years, and I want to share my perspective on the world. I always aim to find small moments of vivid color in New York's big cities, and growing up in a city where towns buzz with noise and joy, I've learned to slow down and appreciate the quiet beauty of these bustling streets. I shoot all of my photos with an iPhone 13 or a digicam, showing how good photography is often drowned out by the excuse of expensive equipment and gear. As I continue learning and experimenting, this page is where I share my perspective and the stories I find along the way.
